body:
## Summary

Update Sepo agent infrastructure from **v0.2.0** (installed) to **v0.3.0** (bec597687fdb1a1786e7127ee6ddd5ec088f36af).

- Source: `self-evolving/repo@v0.3.0`
- Target branch: `main`

## What's new in v0.3.0

- First-class `/install` support with issue-backed install requests, target fork/branch helpers, and guarded publish behavior
- Read-only secondary GitHub token plumbing for explicit external repository inspection
- Direct `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` support for Claude-backed runs, configurable agent model policy (`AGENT_MODEL_POLICY`), and display-model controls
- Global `AGENT_ENABLED=false` pause guards across all packaged Sepo agent workflows
- Repository goal issue templates and orchestrator guidance for goal-backed parent work
- Provider resolution now uses the JavaScript resolver action (`resolve-provider.js`) with cleaner precedence across route, model-policy, default-provider, and auto-detected settings

## Audit Summary

| Path group | Action |
|---|---|
| `.agent/` (src, docs, action-templates, package.json) | ✅ Updated |
| `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/action.yml` | ✅ Updated |
| `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js` | ✅ Added (new JS resolver) |
| `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.sh` | ⚠️ Left in place (now unused; removal not requested) |
| `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml` | ✅ Updated (model/display_model inputs) |
| `.github/workflows/agent-*.yml` (26 files) | ✅ Updated |
| `README.md` | ⏭️ Skipped (target-owned; see note below) |
| `.gitignore` | ✅ Already up-to-date (no changes needed) |
| `.skills/` | ⏭️ Skipped (not requested) |
| `AGENT.md` | ⏭️ Skipped (not requested) |

**Customizations preserved:** None — this is the Sepo self-hosting repo; all files are agent-owned template files.

**Files preserved (target-only):** `resolve-provider.sh` (orphaned but not removed per policy).

## Memory / Rubrics Branch Status

- `agent/memory`: ✅ exists (`dc83cb5fa3c2f833ab6be60aade1d8b4474d13f3`) — no action needed
- `agent/rubrics`: not yet initialized (known; rubrics bootstrap can be run after merge)

## Validation Results

- `npm --prefix .agent ci`: ✅ passed
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`: ✅ passed (TypeScript compiled cleanly at v0.3.0)
- `npm --prefix .agent test`: ⚠️ 685/686 passed; 1 failure

**Test failure:** `packaged Sepo workflows have a global AGENT_ENABLED job guard` — the test checks that `README.md` contains `AGENT_ENABLED=false`, but this string was added in v0.3.0 to the template README. The root `README.md` is outside the standard update scope. To fix: after merging, add `, or set \`AGENT_ENABLED=false\` to pause all Sepo agent workflows` to the scheduled-workflows sentence in `README.md` (line 71). This is purely a documentation addition.

- YAML parsing: not run separately (TypeScript build validates all imported YAML schemas; workflow YAML has no TypeScript coverage)

## Post-Merge Notes

1. No new secrets required — `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is now wired through but optional; existing `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` continues to work
2. New `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` repo variable can be set for model/reasoning-effort overrides (optional)
3. New `AGENT_ENABLED=false` repo variable can be set to pause all agent workflows (optional)
4. `resolve-provider.sh` is now orphaned — can be manually removed from `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/` in a follow-up commit
5. Fix README.md as noted above to make the full test suite pass
6. Optionally run `Agent / Rubrics / Initialization` if rubric steering is desired
7. Smoke-test: open an issue mentioning `@sepo-agent /answer` to verify the updated workflows respond correctly
